method: A nonlinguistic finite urn procedure, seed 35017: at each position independently draw one of 40 predeclared character tails uniformly. Prefix o and then prepend q with probability 0.85 - 0.70 times fractional line position. Lines have 8 to 12 slots selected uniformly. There is no semantic content or phrase copying; the sole decaying line-state explicitly writes the tested positional bias into the generator, so a successful result is a weak, deliberately engineered refutation. The 40 tails are fixed rather than estimated from held-out material. Sampling is independent across slots.
